endorsements.quote: Pre-registered external and temporal hold-outs. Reserve at least one site and a post-freeze time window untouched untilfinal evaluation; report cross-site, cross-language and cross-device transfer.

Stratified calibration and realistic operating points.R e p o r t calibration and predictive values at plausible disease prevalence, stratified by site, device and language, not only balanced case-control accuracy.
Device and channel robustness. Characterize sensitivity to microphone, codec and channel; prefer features and tasks that survive consumer-hardware capture.
Pre-registered external and temporal hold-outs. Reserve at least one site and a post-freeze time window untouched untilfinal evaluation; report cross-site, cross-language and cross-device transfer.

Accent, dialect, language, education and recording conditions materially affect acousticfeatures, so models trained on narrow populations can encode and amplify disparities; calibration should be reported at realistic disease prevalence and strati fied by site, device and language.

Breakthrough Device designation, De Novo marketing authorization, drug-development-tool quali fication and acceptance of an exploratory or secondary trial end point are distinct and should not be conflated.

unlisted_practices: Partition validation data by speaker, never by recording, and report leave-one-subject-out or grouped cross-validation.
Test explicitly whether the model encodes speaker identity rather than disease biology.
Model and report age, sex, language, dialect, education, medication state and comorbid mood disorder, and show performance above a demographics-only baseline.
For monitoring claims, report test-retest reliability in stable patients, responsiveness, and time-to-detect meaningful change, not diagnostic AUROC alone.
Use deterministic, validated task delivery and a human-escalation pathway for any conversational agent used for measurement.
Obtain consent that explicitly covers reuse of voice content and safeguard against re-identification, attribute inference, memorization and model inversion.
Establish governance for raw audio, embeddings and derived features, including consent withdrawal, spoofing or replay, and incident response.
Compare foundation models prospectively against disease-specific self-supervised models, hand-crafted-feature models, demographics-only baselines and no-pretraining controls.
Specify the reference standard, intended user, action and consequences of false positive and false negative results for each context of use.
Do not use voice biomarker models for stand-alone diagnosis; frame them as adjunctive measurement or triage within explicit contexts of use.
Pre-specify estimands and missing-not-at-random sensitivity analyses and provide accessible alternatives for participants unable to complete speech tasks.
Benchmark speech biomarkers against fluid biomarkers such as neurofilament light chain and use representative clinical comparators rather than healthy controls alone.

Reserve the term clinical voice foundation model for models meeting criteria for scale, diversity, multi-condition breadth, task breadth, transferable representations, external and longitudinal validation, and governance.
Disclose conflicts of interest and separate evidence, inference and proposed strategy.

screen.reason: This is a Perspective article that presents a roadmap, proposed standards, and recommendations for developing and clinically validating voice-biomarker foundation models in ALS and Parkinson's disease.
